column1: # Story Run Starter arcs: one 3-beat arc per Remembrance line (arc_rm_<line>). Built by tools/story/build-starter-arcs.mjs.
# line|Name|place|struggle (beat 1)|turning point (beat 2)|answer (beat 3)

bulbasaur|Bulbasaur|an overgrown greenhouse|It waters a wilted sprout with its vines again and again, as if keeping one small thing alive is its job.|A wild Pokémon tramples the sprout. Bulbasaur plants itself in front of what is left and will not move.|Bulbasaur no longer guards one sprout. It guards the whole team, and it seems to have decided that was the point all along.

charmander|Charmander|a rain-soaked bridge|It curls around its tail flame every time the rain picks up, shaking more than the cold explains.|The rain turns to a downpour. Charmander looks at the storm, then at you, and steps out from under cover.|Charmander's flame burns brighter in the rain now. It decided that a fire worth carrying is one you do not hide.

squirtle|Squirtle|a quiet harbour|It plays tricks on everyone, but the jokes stop the moment a bigger Pokémon looks its way.|A Wingull steals its shell polish. Squirtle chases it to the end of the pier and has to choose: laugh it off, or stand its ground.|Squirtle still jokes, but now it jokes after it has stood its ground. The laugh comes easier that way.

chikorita|Chikorita|a sunlit meadow|It keeps brushing its leaf against you, checking that you are still there.|A wild Pokémon in the meadow is hurt and alone. Chikorita leaves your side for the first time to help it.|Chikorita learned that caring for you does not mean never leaving your side. It comes back every time, and that is enough.

cyndaquil|Cyndaquil|a cold mountain pass|Its back flames flicker out whenever it is startled, and it hates that you saw.|An avalanche rumbles above the pass. Cyndaquil's flames sputter, then catch.|Cyndaquil's flames stay lit now, even when it is afraid. It does not have to be fearless, only lit.

totodile|Totodile|a fishing village|It steals bait from every bucket in the village and grins while it does.|An old fisher stops shouting and just looks tired. Totodile drops the bait and does not know what to do with its jaws.|Totodile still bites at everything, but now it chooses what. It brought the fisher a fish the next morning.

treecko|Treecko|a tall forest canopy|It climbs ahead and waits on high branches, as if travelling with someone is something it is still deciding about.|A branch snaps under it. You are the one who catches it.|Treecko still climbs ahead. It just looks back now, every few branches, to make sure you are coming too.

torchic|Torchic|a training ground|It challenges every Pokémon it sees and loses most of the time, then glares at you as if you should have warned it.|A trainer laughs at its tiny flame. Torchic does not attack. It trains, alone, until dark.|Torchic stopped picking fights to prove itself. It fights to get stronger now, and it is winning more.

mudkip|Mudkip|a muddy riverbank|It refuses to leave the river even when the team moves on, digging its feet into the mud.|The river floods. Mudkip finally sees why it was so stubborn: it was listening to the water.|Mudkip's stubbornness turned into something steadier. It trusts its own senses now, and you trust them too.

turtwig|Turtwig|a grove of old trees|It watches the old trees for hours, serious and silent, as if waiting to be told something.|A wildfire threatens the grove. Turtwig does not wait for anyone to tell it what to do.|Turtwig still listens to the old trees. But it learned that sometimes the one who has to speak is itself.

chimchar|Chimchar|a busy city square|It bounces off every wall, too fast to sit still, and other trainers keep asking you to calm it down.|A child gets lost in the crowd. Chimchar's restless energy is the only thing quick enough to find her.|Chimchar is still never still. But now it knows its energy can be pointed at something that matters.

piplup|Piplup|an icy shoreline|It refuses help from anyone, even when it slips on the ice in front of everybody.|It falls through thin ice. You reach for it, and for once Piplup takes the help.|Piplup is still proud. It just learned that pride and accepting a hand can live in the same Pokémon.

snivy|Snivy|an old library|It studies every battle afterward, cold and quiet, and seems to judge your choices.|It makes a plan that fails badly. For the first time Snivy looks to you instead of to its own thinking.|Snivy still plans everything. But its plans include you now, and they are better for it.

tepig|Tepig|a roadside diner|It snorts warm puffs of smoke at every stranger, hoping each one will be a friend.|A Pokémon it befriended leaves without looking back. Tepig sits outside the diner for a long time.|Tepig still loves easily. It learned that a friend who leaves does not take the warmth with them.

oshawott|Oshawott|a waterfall shrine|It practises with its scalchop for hours, but it drops it every time someone watches.|A rival's Pokémon mocks its form. Oshawott raises its scalchop, hands steady for once.|Oshawott does not drop its scalchop anymore. It found out it fights best when it stops worrying who is watching.

chespin|Chespin|a sheltered valley|It raises its spines at every noise and puts itself between you and everything.|The noise turns out to be a frightened Pokémon. Chespin lowers its spines and offers it a nut instead.|Chespin still protects you. It just learned that sometimes protecting means letting someone in.

fennekin|Fennekin|a stargazing hill|It stares into the fire at camp as if reading something there, then won't tell you what.|One night the fire shows it a path. Fennekin leads, and it is right.|Fennekin trusts what it sees in the flames now, and it shares what it sees with you.

froakie|Froakie|a misty marsh|It hides in the mist and pelts the team with bubbles, then vanishes before anyone can scold it.|The mist thickens and the team gets separated. Froakie is the only one who can find everyone.|Froakie still disappears into the mist. It just always comes back with someone it found.

rowlet|Rowlet|a moonlit ruin|It sleeps through almost everything, then wakes with its feathers on end at the smallest sound.|Something moves in the ruin. Rowlet is awake before anyone else and does not hesitate.|Rowlet still naps. But when it matters, it is the first one awake.

litten|Litten|a back alley|It eats alone, away from the team, and hisses when anyone comes too close.|You leave a share of your food by its side and walk away. Later, it is sitting next to you.|Litten still keeps its distance from most of the world. Not from you.

popplio|Popplio|a seaside stage|It practises balloons all day, but they pop the moment anyone claps.|A crowd gathers. Popplio's balloon wobbles and holds.|Popplio's balloons hold now. It learned that the clapping was never the scary part.

grookey|Grookey|a forest clearing|It drums on everything, all the time, and the noise drives the team a little mad.|The team is lost in the dark. Grookey's drumming is the beat everyone follows home.|Grookey still drums. The team listens now, because that beat brought them home once.

scorbunny|Scorbunny|a dusty pitch|It sprints into every fight without thinking and burns its feet on the ground.|It charges a foe that is far too strong. You call it back, and it actually listens.|Scorbunny is still fast. It learned that the best sprint starts with one look back at you.

sobble|Sobble|a crowded market|It turns invisible whenever a stranger speaks, and sometimes cries when it can't.|A child in the market is crying too. Sobble stays visible and sits beside her.|Sobble still hides sometimes. It learned that being seen can be a kind thing to do for someone else.

sprigatito|Sprigatito|a flower garden|It knocks things off tables just to watch you pick them up.|It knocks over something that matters to you. Sprigatito sees your face and freezes.|Sprigatito still makes mischief. It brought you a flower the next day, and it did not knock that one over.

fuecoco|Fuecoco|a picnic ground|It naps through training and wakes only for snacks.|A hungry wild Pokémon eyes the team's food. Fuecoco gets up, slowly, and shares.|Fuecoco is still unhurried. It learned that some things are worth getting up for.

quaxly|Quaxly|a city fountain|It straightens its feathers before every battle and fusses if anything is out of place.|A battle leaves it soaked and scruffy. It won anyway, and nobody cared about the feathers.|Quaxly still keeps its feathers neat. It learned that it is not the tidiness that wins.

dratini|Dratini|a still lake|It circles the lake shore as if looking for someone who used to be there.|A shimmer under the water. It is only a reflection, but Dratini watches it for a long time.|Dratini stopped circling the lake. It found who it was looking for: the team it travels with now.

larvitar|Larvitar|a gravel quarry|It eats through rocks the team needs to cross and refuses to stop.|The quarry collapses. Larvitar holds up the stone above you while everyone gets clear.|Larvitar is still as stubborn as stone. It decided that the thing worth being stubborn about is the team.

bagon|Bagon|a cliff edge|It jumps from every ledge it finds, trying to fly, and lands hard every time.|It stands at the tallest cliff yet. This time it waits for you before it jumps.|Bagon still dreams of flying. It learned that it does not have to jump alone.

beldum|Beldum|an abandoned lab|It hovers in place for long minutes, computing something it will not share.|The lab's old machines switch on. Beldum turns them off, one by one, then looks to you.|Beldum still calculates everything. You are the one variable it decided not to compute.

gible|Gible|a sandy cave|It bites everything it finds, including the team's bags and once your hat.|A rockfall traps a wild Pokémon. Gible bites through the stone to free it.|Gible still bites far too much. But it learned what its jaws are good for.

deino|Deino|a dark canyon|It can't see well and charges at anything that moves, friend or foe.|It charges at you in the dark, then stops: it knows your voice.|Deino still charges. But it stops when you speak, every time.

goomy|Goomy|a rainy road|It hides from every raindrop, even though it is made of slime.|The rain stops. Goomy looks almost disappointed.|Goomy learned to love the rain. And it learned that hiding was never really what it wanted.

jangmo_o|Jangmo-o|a mountain dojo|It clangs its scales at every Pokémon it meets, demanding a battle.|An old dojo master's Pokémon refuses to fight it. Jangmo-o is confused into silence.|Jangmo-o still loves to battle. It learned that the best battles are the ones both sides want.

dreepy|Dreepy|a foggy graveyard|It drifts away from the team at night, toward somewhere it will not explain.|You follow it and find where it was going: a place it used to call home.|Dreepy still drifts sometimes. But it always drifts back to you now.

frigibax|Frigibax|a frozen pass|It refuses to be warmed by the fire, sitting stubbornly in the snow.|A blizzard hits. Frigibax finally comes close, and the fire lets it.|Frigibax still loves the cold. It just learned that warmth from a friend does not melt anything important.

pichu|Pichu|a power station|It sparks at everything, then flinches from its own static.|The station's lights go out. Pichu's tiny spark is the only light left.|Pichu still shocks itself sometimes. But it learned how much light one small spark can make.

tuftin|Tuftin|a cosy farmhouse|It follows you everywhere, even into places it is clearly scared of.|It gets lost in the barn, alone. When you find it, it is not crying.|Tuftin still follows you everywhere. But it learned it could be brave without you, too.

magby|Magby|a volcanic vent|It breathes fire at everything that annoys it, which is most things.|Its fire sets a field alight. Magby is the first to stamp it out.|Magby still has a temper. It learned that fire you can control is worth more than fire you can't.

elekid|Elekid|a storm-wracked tower|It challenges the thunder itself, arms whirling.|Lightning strikes near you. Elekid takes the charge so you do not have to.|Elekid still wants to beat the storm. It learned that some fights are worth fighting for someone else.

togepi|Togepi|a nursery garden|It giggles at everything, even when things are going badly.|Things go very badly. Togepi giggles anyway, and somehow the team laughs with it.|Togepi's luck may be real or not. Its cheer certainly is.

aron|Aron|an iron mine|It eats the rails, the tools and very nearly the cart.|The mine's supports start to give. Aron stands under them, solid as steel.|Aron still eats iron. It learned that being solid is a gift you can give to others.

pidgey|Pidgey|a windy plain|It flies in circles, never landing, like it is afraid to stop.|A gust knocks it down. It lands on your shoulder and stays there.|Pidgey still loves to fly. It learned that landing is part of flying too.

hoothoot|Hoothoot|a night forest|It stands on one foot all night, counting something.|It counts the stars and finds one missing. It leads you to a lost Pokémon under it.|Hoothoot still counts everything. It learned that some things are worth counting.

taillow|Taillow|a stormy sky|It dives at bigger Pokémon without fear and gets knocked out of the sky.|A huge flying Pokémon threatens the team. Taillow dives, and this time it does not miss.|Taillow is still braver than it is big. It learned that bravery and skill can grow together.

starly|Starly|a flock's roost|It keeps flying back to a flock that does not seem to want it.|The flock is attacked. Starly fights for them anyway.|Starly does not need the flock's welcome anymore. It found a team that flies with it.

pidove|Pidove|a busy station|It hides under benches whenever a crowd passes.|It gets separated in the crowd. It finds you by itself.|Pidove still dislikes crowds. It learned that it can find its way through them.

fletchling|Fletchling|a race course|It races every Pokémon it meets and sulks when it loses.|It loses a race to a slower Pokémon that never gave up. Fletchling thinks about that.|Fletchling still loves to race. It learned that the race is against yourself.

pikipek|Pikipek|an old orchard|It pecks holes in everything, including the camp's cooking pot.|It pecks a rhythm on a tree, and the team starts humming along.|Pikipek still pecks too much. But now it pecks songs.

rookidee|Rookidee|a crossroads|It takes every challenge seriously, even the silly ones.|A small Pokémon challenges it to a game of tag. Rookidee plays, very seriously, and loses.|Rookidee is still serious. It learned that losing a silly game can be the best part of the day.

wattrel|Wattrel|a stormy coast|It flies into storms for fun and comes back crackling and pleased.|A storm gets too strong. Wattrel comes back to the team first, before anything else.|Wattrel still loves storms. It learned that coming home is part of the fun.

rhyhorn|Rhyhorn|a rocky gorge|It charges in a straight line and never turns, no matter what is in the way.|You are in the way. Rhyhorn turns.|Rhyhorn still charges straight. It learned that the one thing worth turning for is you.

porygon|Porygon|a data centre|It flickers when it is nervous and asks the same questions over and over.|A system crash scrambles its memory. It remembers you first.|Porygon still worries. It learned that the most important data is the kind you never lose.

mankey|Mankey|a mountain trail|It loses its temper at rocks, trees and its own reflection.|It loses its temper at you, then stops, ashamed.|Mankey still gets angry. It learned that you will stay anyway, and that makes it calmer.

gastly|Gastly|an old mansion|It sneaks up and spooks everyone, then cackles.|A real ghost spooks Gastly. It hides behind you for the first time.|Gastly still loves a good fright. It learned that it likes being safe too.

abra|Abra|a sleepy village|It sleeps eighteen hours a day and teleports away from anything boring.|Something important happens while it is asleep. Abra wakes and teleports to help.|Abra still sleeps a lot. It learned how to tell when something matters enough to wake up.

machop|Machop|a training gym|It lifts heavy things all day to show off its muscles.|It cannot lift something on its own. It asks for help.|Machop is still strong. It learned that asking for help is a kind of strength too.

magnemite|Magnemite|a broken power line|It hums at fixed intervals and does exactly what it is told.|Someone gives it a bad order. Magnemite stops humming and does what is right.|Magnemite still follows the rules. It learned that the best rule is to think for itself.

shinx|Shinx|a dark tunnel|It flashes its fur at every shadow, ready to fight.|The tunnel goes black. Shinx's glow is the only way through.|Shinx is still ready to fight. It learned that its light is for showing the way too.

weedle|Weedle|a forest path|It stays close and bristles at anything that approaches you.|An old friend from the forest calls to it. Weedle looks back at you and stays.|Weedle chose you. It still bristles at strangers, but it never doubts where it belongs.

caterpie|Caterpie|a cocoon tree|It watches butterflies overhead as if it already knows it will be one of them.|It sees a fallen Butterfree. Caterpie stays with it until the end.|Caterpie still dreams of flying. It learned that there is grace in every stage, even this one.

nidoran_f|Nidoran♀|a burrow field|It guards the burrows of strangers as if they were its own family.|A burrow collapses. Nidoran♀ digs until everyone is out.|Nidoran♀ still guards everyone. It learned that the team is the burrow it guards most.

nidoran_m|Nidoran♂|a rocky slope|It charges at anything with a horn bigger than its own.|It meets a Pokémon with a much bigger horn that only wants to play. Nidoran♂ is confused.|Nidoran♂ still charges. It learned that not every horn is a challenge.

poliwag|Poliwag|a lily pond|It spins in circles when it is happy and dizzies itself.|It spins to cheer up a sad Pokémon, and the Pokémon laughs.|Poliwag still spins. It learned that its swirl can make others happy too.

oddish|Oddish|a midnight field|It wanders off at night to plant itself under the moon.|One night it does not come back. You find it watching over a sprouting seed.|Oddish still wanders at night. It learned that it always has someone to come back to.

swinub|Swinub|a snowy trail|It digs for food in the snow and will not stop even when the team moves on.|It digs up something wonderful and shares it.|Swinub is still stubborn about digging. It learned that what it finds is better shared.

ralts|Ralts|a quiet station|It hides behind you whenever strong feelings fill a room.|Your feelings fill the room. Ralts does not hide this time.|Ralts still feels everything. It learned that feelings are a way to understand, not only to fear.

trapinch|Trapinch|a desert pit|It waits at the bottom of a pit for hours, very serious about it.|Nothing comes. Trapinch climbs out and follows you instead.|Trapinch still loves a good pit. It learned that waiting is not the only way to catch what you want.

duskull|Duskull|a lantern-lit graveyard|It drifts between gravestones as if checking on old friends.|It leads you to one grave in particular, then stays very still.|Duskull still watches over the departed. It learned that it can watch over the living too.

sandile|Sandile|a sun-baked dune|It keeps its eyes half closed and trusts nobody.|You fall asleep in the sun. When you wake, Sandile is still keeping watch.|Sandile still trusts almost nobody. It decided you are not almost nobody.

pawniard|Pawniard|an old barracks|It follows orders exactly and looks lost without them.|You give it no order. It has to choose for itself.|Pawniard still respects orders. It learned that the best orders are the ones it would choose anyway.

grubbin|Grubbin|a charging station|It digs into everything to see what is inside.|It digs into a broken machine and finds a way to fix it.|Grubbin is still curious about everything. It learned that curiosity can build as well as dig.

blipbug|Blipbug|a radio tower|It hides from loud signals and covers its antennae.|It hears a quiet distress call under the noise. Only Blipbug could have heard it.|Blipbug still dislikes noise. It learned that its sharp hearing is a gift.

vulpix|Vulpix|a lantern-lit festival|It hides behind you whenever the festival crowds come close, its six tails tucked tight.|A lantern topples and a stall catches fire. Vulpix steps out from behind you and draws the flames into its tails.|Vulpix still dislikes crowds. It learned that its fire can calm things down as well as light them up.

psyduck|Psyduck|a muddy pond|It holds its head and waddles in circles whenever the team argues.|A wild Pokémon charges the team. Psyduck's headache flares, and so does a wave of psychic power.|Psyduck still gets headaches. It learned that the pressure inside it can be turned into something that protects the team.

eevee|Eevee|a dusty attic|It sniffs every stone and every feather, as if it could become any of them and cannot choose.|A strange glow hums in a box of old things. Eevee presses against it, and its fur stands up.|Eevee stopped waiting to be told what to become. It carries a little glow now, and it chose where to point it.

toxel|Toxel|a back-street music hall|It tunes itself to every noise it hears, and the noise leaves it jittery and sparking.|A guitar lies abandoned on the stage. Toxel plays one wrong note, then another, then a whole riff.|Toxel is still loud. It learned that a sound it makes on purpose is the best kind of noise.

shieldon|Shieldon|a drowned quarry|It sits under the dripping rock for hours, heavy and slow, and will not be hurried.|The old sludge pools rise. Shieldon plants itself in front of the team and takes the splash on its shield.|Shieldon is still slow. It learned that being the last thing between a friend and the water is worth the wait.
